name: Miracle
source:
Being at the brink of insanity, Mello begins trying desperately harder to outdo his rival Near, even going so far as to bypass Christmas. However, on the eves of this beautiful holiday, a small hitch is thrown in his way, the competition for number 1 growing into an evermore complicated mind game. Emotions get the better of him, and in the end, the catalyst this holiday provides may just as well ruin himself, his mind, and his rival.

[From [url=http://haleybopcomet.deviantart.com/art/Miracle-DEMO-345607525]DeviantArt[/url]]

A Mello/Near Death Note fan game.
translation:
处于疯狂的边缘，梅洛开始拼命地试图超越他的对手尼亚，甚至绕过圣诞节。然而，在这个美丽的假期前夕，一个小麻烦出现在他的路上，第一名的竞争逐渐演变成一场更加复杂的心理游戏。情绪控制了他，最终，这个假期提供的催化剂可能会毁了他自己、他的思想和他的对手。

[来自[url=http://haleybopcomet.deviantart.com/art/Miracle-DEMO-345607525]异常艺术[/url]]

梅洛/濒死笔记粉丝游戏。
